name: Maine Street Meats
old_description: Join us for morning coffee, tea or espresso and savor a freshly baked pastry. Take home one of our sourdough breads, baguettes or rustic loaves.
about:
Bleecker & Greer operates from a restored 19th-century one-room schoolhouse in Rockport, Maine, a location it has occupied since 2019. The business began in 2012 as a full-service butcher shop selling Maine-raised meats and poultry before expanding into a multi-faceted food destination.

The company combines a butcher counter, bakery, cafe, grocery, deli, and wine and beer selection under one roof. Its culinary team practices nose-to-tail butchering daily, breaking down whole animals to produce house-made charcuterie, sausages, bone stocks, and rendering fat for cooking. The bakery turns out sourdough loaves, baguettes, rustic breads, and pastries each morning, while the kitchen prepares ready-to-heat entrees, stews, pot pies, and soups. Seasonal produce, pantry staples, and local cheeses round out the market shelves.

The shop serves retail customers throughout Maine's Midcoast region, from daily coffee drinkers and lunch patrons to home cooks seeking sustainably raised meats and artisanal provisions. Its supply chain draws on small, family-run farms in Newcastle, Washington, and surrounding areas where land and animal stewardship are priorities.

The founders frame the operation as a holistic retail model designed to keep both the business and its farm partners viable. By utilizing every part of the animal and selling directly to the community, they aim to preserve a rural agricultural economy that defines the region.
